name: Explora Valle Sagrado
positioning: Explora lodge in Peru's Sacred Valley where three daily meals, an open bar and access to the outdoor pools, jacuzzis, sauna and steam baths are included in the stay
best_for: Travelers who want meals, an open bar and pool, sauna and steam access included in their stay
Guests who want spa treatments such as Inca Feet and Pumacahua Reiki

facts.text: Access to the outdoor swimming pools and jacuzzis is included in the stay.
Access to the sauna and steam baths is included in the stay.
The spa massage menu includes a relaxing massage, a deep tissue massage and reflexology.
The spa offers an Inca Feet treatment of a massage with an optional jacuzzi.
The spa offers a Pumacahua Reiki treatment combining chakra balancing, reiki and craniosacral massage.
The spa also offers a Pumacahua Special massage.
On departure day, guests may leave their luggage at reception and join an exploration during the morning.
Three daily meals, chosen from a set menu, are included in the stay.
An open bar with spirits and an a la carte selection of food and wines is included in the stay.
Each room has a safety-deposit box for valuables.
Explora Valle Sagrado was named to the Conde Nast Traveler Gold List in 2022.

considerations.text: Spa treatments are charged separately, in US dollars at the current exchange rate.
Tips are voluntary; they are left at reception at the end of the stay and shared among everyone who contributed to the trip.
WhataHotel notes the high-altitude setting may require acclimatization.
